description: ClinicalTrials.gov study search (API v2): NCT ID, title, status, phase, start and completion dates, sponsor, conditions, interventions, enrollment and primary outcome. Up to 10 studies per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_clinical_evidence_cochrane when you need Cochrane systematic reviews of health interventions, found; health_clinical_pharmacogenetics when you need CPIC pharmacogenetics guidelines for a gene symbol. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Search term (condition, drug, sponsor), 2 to 200 characters
